oracle.expected: For both public entries, diagnostics is a nonempty JSON-compatible list with length no greater than the independently frozen finite policy limit, including under excess-defect input. Every returned entry contains rule, path and message information. Check the policy and result-schema artifacts during contract evaluation for a finite bound and required diagnostic fields; do not derive expected limits or required fields from candidate-controlled bytes at test time.
forbidden: An unbounded diagnostics list or a returned count exceeding the frozen limit.
A diagnostic entry missing rule, path or message information.
Passing an empty diagnostics list for every defective input.
Treating a missing production import, absent test file, timeout or environment failure as causal RED.
